continuity.notes: Revised landscape pass: use the D001 idol reference as the authority for the specific Guruvayur temple murti whenever a stanza depicts that idol, especially stanza 1. Preserve its visible complexion, face, stance, crown, garlands, and clothing. For narrative or symbolic divine forms in the other stanzas, use the approved youthful deep-blue Guruvayurappan character identity. Keep the matte temple-mural treatment and full-bleed framing across the set; vary scene symbolism without changing the intended depiction. Portraits remain paused.

stanzas.reference_guidance: For this stanza only, intake/D001/001.jpg is the authority for the specific Guruvayur temple murti's visible appearance: pale ivory-white surface, face proportions, frontal stance, pointed jeweled headpiece, layered light garlands, ornaments, and two-arm pose. Match those visible idol features closely. Do not replace them with the generic blue skin, peacock feather, yellow dhoti, or red shawl of narrative Krishna depictions. Use D002 S1 only for the series' flat matte mural paint treatment, not for Krishna identity, pose, clothing, or composition. Recompose the portrait reference as a true 16:9 landscape and omit its black outer frame.

must_show: The full standing Guruvayur temple murti, faithfully matching the D001 reference's pale ivory-white surface, round calm face, frontal two-arm pose, pointed jeweled headpiece, layered light garlands, ornaments, and simple pale clothing
A warm ochre-gold sanctum arch and traditional oil lamps, with a boundless calm field of bliss and consciousness opening subtly beyond the shrine
The sense that time and space do not limit Brahman, shown with fading celestial cycles and dissolving horizon boundaries, without clocks, coordinates, or text
Scriptural wisdom suggested only by small abstract palm-leaf forms in the architecture, without legible marks
scene_brief.composition: Full-bleed 16:9 landscape; centered full-length temple murti in its ornate sanctum niche, surrounded by the source reference's stacked garlands and decorated arch; widen the scene with restrained temple space and subtle cosmic depth, preserving the reference silhouette; no black outer frame
scene_brief.tone: awe + reverence; fortunate devotees implied (small silhouettes with folded hands)

stanzas.reference_guidance: Use intake/D001/001.jpg for the sanctum murti stance and temple setting; use the approved character sheet for the youthful deep-blue two-armed Guruvayurappan identity; use D001 S008 only as a matte mural rendering reference. Stage devotees as separate, complete figures with clear personal space and exactly two natural arms each. No overlapping bodies, hidden extra hands, duplicated limbs, or crowded vignette circles.

must_show: The complete two-armed youthful blue Guruvayurappan murti, clearly visible in the sanctum as the rare, accessible supreme refuge
Two visually separate paths before the sanctum: a calm ascending path of study, humility, and surrendered devotion, and a descending path of grasping, anger, pride, and distraction

Three individually readable focal devotees: one seated with a simple palm-leaf/book form, one kneeling with joined palms on the calm path, and one solitary worldly seeker distracted by a small coin pouch on the descending path. Small distant background worshippers may appear only as separated secondary figures; every person has exactly two naturally attached arms and clear space around the body.
scene_brief.composition: Wide full-bleed temple mural with the full two-armed murti as the stable focal anchor. Separate the calm ascending path and restless descending path with clear open space. Stage the three focal human figures distinctly, with both arms readable and no overlap. Small secondary worshippers may appear far in the background, individually separated and without cropped or ambiguous limbs. Avoid crowds, close interactions, and symbolic portrait circles; no labels or outer border.
scene_brief.tone: contrast restless vs serene; devotional reverence; no parody
avoid: any readable words in the image
more than two arms on any human figure
